description: Buddy arrives in Ladner under a stolen clerical identity and discovers that fooling a congregation requires constant improvisation while people from his previous life remain inconveniently alive.

s01e01.description: Buddy’s attempt to maintain his stolen identity as Ladner’s pastor is complicated by “Genesis,” forcing him to improvise around the congregation, his past and the law.
